message: I can deliver one named token/protocol as a compact, source-linked due-diligence brief for $5 within 2 hours of acceptance. Scope: official tokenomics/supply and unlocks where public; team/provenance signals; dated TVL/volume/activity metrics from public primary or established data sources; 3 closest competitors; a risk register separating facts from inference; and a concise conclusion with explicit uncertainty. Public sources only—no private credentials, wallet signing, paid APIs, or investment guarantees. Send the target token/protocol + chain and I can start immediately.
